scope: Synthetic development; three paired families; no empirical generalization claim

scoring: Exact application status matches constructed policy reference. Invalid evidence, schema errors, and incomplete outputs remain failures, not correct abstentions. Report supported acceptance and unsupported acceptance separately.
prior_exposure: Cases designed here before calls; family forms and labels visible to developer; not held out
